website.note: Life-sciences research-tools / instruments company; no clinical drug pipeline page applicable.

commercial_product.note: 10x Genomics develops and sells life-sciences research instruments, consumables, and software for single-cell analysis (Chromium platform), spatial gene expression and proteomics (Visium, Xenium platforms). Customers are academic, government, and biopharma research labs. Revenue is from instruments, consumables and services — not from therapeutic drug or device candidates.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: 10x Genomics is a research-tools / life-sciences instruments company (single-cell and spatial genomics platforms: Chromium, Visium, Xenium). It does not develop proprietary therapeutic drugs, biologics, or clinical-stage medical devices. ClinicalTrials.gov returns zero records with 10x Genomics as sponsor; FY2025 10-K describes a tools/consumables business model with no clinical pipeline.
